faqs.question: How does multi-tenancy protect school data isolation?
faqs.answer: Every school campus operates within its own encrypted database partition. Student grades, staff registers, and financials are strictly separated. School administrators only access their campus, while the platform owner exercises high-level governance.

faqs.question: Is EduSmart compliant with Ministry of Education CBC guidelines?
faqs.answer: Yes! EduSmart natively supports Kenyan CBC strands, sub-strands, formative rubrics, and KNEC CBA termly scoring rubrics for Grades 1 to 9, outputting compliant report cards automatically.

faqs.question: Does the system work during power or internet outages?
faqs.answer: Yes. EduSmart has an integrated offline sync engine with IndexedDB persistence. Roll-call attendance and lesson marks can be entered without internet and will automatically sync once connection is restored.

faqs.question: How do M-Pesa fee payments get reconciled?
faqs.answer: We connect directly to your school M-Pesa Paybill or Till number. When parents pay using the student admission number as account reference, the platform reconciles the balance and sends an automated SMS receipt within seconds.
